-- Native operational projections. No migration target/audit JSON is read. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credesal_currency_amount(value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE SQL IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $money$ SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(value,0),2) - CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(COALESCE(value,0))*100,1)=0.5 AND MOD(TRUNC(ABS(COALESCE(value,0))*100),2)=0 THEN SIGN(value)*0.01 ELSE 0 END $money$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credesal_native_loan_metrics(p_loan_id BIGINT, p_as_of_date DATE) RETURNS TABLE ( loan_id BIGINT, metric_date DATE, paid_principal NUMERIC, outstanding_principal NUMERIC, paid_interest NUMERIC, accrued_interest NUMERIC, due_principal NUMERIC, mora NUMERIC, insurance_paid NUMERIC, insurance_owed NUMERIC, future_insurance NUMERIC, scheduled_fee_outstanding NUMERIC, other_fee_outstanding NUMERIC, projection_available BOOLEAN, native_state_date DATE ) LANGUAGE SQL STABLE AS $metrics$ WITH state_date AS ( SELECT GREATEST(l.disbursedon_date,l.last_closed_business_date, (SELECT MAX(r.duedate) FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule r WHERE r.loan_id=l.id AND r.migration_metric_baseline), (SELECT MAX(GREATEST(t.transaction_date,t.reversed_on_date)) FROM m_loan_transaction t WHERE t.loan_id=l.id)) AS native_state_date FROM m_loan l WHERE l.id=p_loan_id ), schedule_values AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.principal_amount-COALESCE(r.principal_completed_derived,0) -COALESCE(r.principal_writtenoff_derived,0)) FILTER (WHERE r.duedate<=p_as_of_date),0) AS due_principal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.duedate<=p_as_of_date+1 THEN COALESCE(r.interest_amount,0)-COALESCE(r.interest_completed_derived,0) -COALESCE(r.interest_waived_derived,0)-COALESCE(r.interest_writtenoff_derived,0) WHEN r.fromdate<=p_as_of_date+1 AND r.duedate>r.fromdate THEN credesal_currency_amount(GREATEST( COALESCE(r.interest_amount,0)*(p_as_of_date+1-r.fromdate)::NUMERIC /(r.duedate-r.fromdate) -COALESCE(r.interest_completed_derived,0)-COALESCE(r.interest_waived_derived,0),0)) ELSE 0 END),0) AS accrued_interest FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule r WHERE r.loan_id=p_loan_id ), identified_charges AS ( SELECT c.*, (definition.charge_calculation_enum=8 OR definition.name='Arissto historical debt-insurance allocation') AND NOT c.is_penalty AS is_insurance FROM m_loan_charge c JOIN m_charge definition ON definition.id=c.charge_id WHERE c.loan_id=p_loan_id AND c.is_active ), installment_due AS ( SELECT i.loan_charge_id, SUM(credesal_currency_amount(i.amount_outstanding_derived)) FILTER (WHERE r.duedate<=p_as_of_date) AS due_amount, SUM(credesal_currency_amount(i.amount_outstanding_derived)) FILTER (WHERE r.duedate>p_as_of_date) AS future_amount FROM m_loan_installment_charge i JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule r ON r.id=i.loan_schedule_id JOIN identified_charges c ON c.id=i.loan_charge_id GROUP BY i.loan_charge_id ), charge_values AS ( SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.charge_time_enum=8 THEN COALESCE(i.due_amount,0) WHEN c.due_for_collection_as_of_date<=p_as_of_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(c.amount_outstanding_derived) ELSE 0 END AS due_amount, CASE WHEN c.charge_time_enum=8 THEN COALESCE(i.future_amount,0) WHEN c.due_for_collection_as_of_date>p_as_of_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(c.amount_outstanding_derived) ELSE 0 END AS future_amount FROM identified_charges c LEFT JOIN installment_due i ON i.loan_charge_id=c.id ), charges AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(due_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_penalty),0) AS mora, COALESCE(SUM(credesal_currency_amount(amount_paid_derived)) FILTER (WHERE is_insurance),0) AS insurance_paid, COALESCE(SUM(due_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_insurance),0) AS insurance_owed, COALESCE(SUM(future_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_insurance),0) AS future_insurance, COALESCE(SUM(credesal_currency_amount(amount_outstanding_derived)) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_penalty AND NOT is_insurance),0) AS other_fee_outstanding FROM charge_values ) SELECT l.id,p_as_of_date, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(l.principal_repaid_derived) END, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(l.principal_outstanding_derived) END, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(l.interest_repaid_derived) END, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(s.accrued_interest) END,CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(s.due_principal) END, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(c.mora) END,CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(c.insurance_paid) END, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(c.insurance_owed) END,CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(c.future_insurance) END, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived) END, CASE WHEN p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date THEN credesal_currency_amount(c.other_fee_outstanding) END, p_as_of_date>=state.native_state_date AS projection_available,state.native_state_date FROM m_loan l CROSS JOIN schedule_values s CROSS JOIN charges c CROSS JOIN state_date state WHERE l.id=p_loan_id $metrics$;
